The '''''Steel Talon''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]]. It was part of the [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] tasked with guarding the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] at [[Despayre]].

During the mission to guard the Death Star, the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Alpha Squadron]] was assigned to duty onboard the ''Steel Talon''.
